_comment: Claude Code / Claude Desktop MCP config — STDIO transport. korrel8r runs as a local subprocess, reads your current `oc login` session for the k8s domain, and reaches the other domains (alert/log/metric/netflow/trace) via the routes named in korrel8r-standalone-config.yaml. Experimental upstream feature (korrel8r MCP support since v0.10.0) — not a Red Hat product integration. Source: https://github.com/korrel8r/korrel8r/blob/main/doc/content/docs/ai-agents.md
_path_note: REPLACE <ABSOLUTE_PATH_TO_ACT3_DIR> below with the absolute path to this act3/ directory ON THE MACHINE RUNNING THE DEMO before use — MCP client launchers resolve args relative to their own working directory, not this file's location, so a relative path will fail to find korrel8r-standalone-config.yaml. Do not reuse any path from a prior scratch/build session.
